description: Turns the maintenance services a driver already has a price for, plus an optional monthly reserve, into a total and a monthly amount over a planning horizon. Every service, month and amount comes from the caller: the engine holds no maintenance schedule, no service interval and no price, and it adds none. Returns the result of the repairworth.com engine unchanged: the services in month order, `plannedLowCents` and `plannedHighCents`, the reserve over the horizon, `totalLowCents` and `totalHighCents`, the monthly amounts, and the flags `totalIsPartial` and `monthlyRounded`. Amounts come back in integer US cents. An input the engine refuses comes back with `valid: false` and the engine's own messages.

events.description: Planned services, at most 24 (a row with every field blank is skipped). A plan needs at least one service or a monthly reserve.

high.description: Upper bound of that price. Leave it out for a single amount. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

low.description: Price the user was given for the service, or its lower bound. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

month.description: Month of the planning horizon in which the service falls, counted from 1. It must fall inside the horizon.

months.description: Planning horizon in whole months, from 1 to 240. Required.

reserveMonthly.description: Optional amount set aside each month for unplanned work. When it is left out the total is flagged as partial. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

name: maintenance_plan
title: Build a Maintenance Plan
